board.note: He kept one line from the first board and, by his own rule, that answers the other eight — so they are retired here rather than shown again. What landed was a definition that bites rather than a fine sentiment, so the seams that produced fine sentiments are closed (Buffett 0 for 3, Kierkegaard 0 for 2, Hayek 0 for 2) and these five are all the keeper’s shape: people inside institutions arguing about what money and haste do to inquiry. Ostrom’s Nobel lecture was read in full and produced nothing that beat what you already hold, so nothing from it is here.
